blocks.line: Back-plan February 2027 — rule BOLO 24's last three calls.
blocks.why: For nineteen days the constraint was a missing date, and last session removed it. What that exposes is that the slice was never short of build; it was short of rulings, and three are left on the same sheet: the library, the split, and the Gate 3 skin test. With a month named, each of them is now a dated task instead of an open question, and four months of runway is enough only if the back-plan starts while the ruling is warm. The pattern to beat is the one this operation keeps repeating — finished work parked on one unanswered call — and three calls on one sheet is the cheapest place to beat it.
